newsitem.title: UK: Williams boosts profits, upbeat on 1997.
newsitem.headline: Williams boosts profits, upbeat on 1997.

text.p: Britain's Williams Holdings Plc said on Wednesday it was confident of making further progress this year as it unveiled a 49 percent increase in 1996 pretax profits.
Williams, which made a recommended 1.3 billion pounds ($2.1 billion) offer for Chubb Security Plc in February, is engaged in fire protection, security and home improvement.

It made pretax profits of 340 million pounds in 1996 compared with 228 million in the previous year and raised its total dividend payout for the year to 15.05 pence per share from 14.25 pence previously.
"The outlook for the group is favoured by increased focus on international business," the company said in a statement.
Williams said that demand for home improvement products was firm both in the UK and North America, and added that it expects some recovery in Continental Europe later in 1997.

It said that the strength of sterling was having only a limited impact on the group's competitive position and underlying earnings performance as much of the company's manufacturing is undertaken within its major markets.
By 0937 GMT, shares in the firm had risen 4-1/2 pence to stand at 333-1/2.
